description: Another fragment of the result of experiments on creating sounds of fire and flame. Here is the sound of a campfire in the forest, in close proximity. The flame gradually flares up and then begins to sway distinctly in the wind. The design uses the original recordings of footsteps through the undergrowth, the crunching of branches, wind sounds and others. There are also synthetic elements, such as one of the layers with clicks and high-pitched squeaks that can be heard when burning wood. I ask you, if possible, to help this wonderful site (not me) stay afloat and develop further. Make a donation https://freesound.org/donations/donate/ if my sounds helped or liked you. Freesound remains free of advertising, let's appreciate it together. As for attribution, you should credit me in your work. How to do this, see here . My sounds can be used within your projects (including commercial ones, if the license assigned to this sound allows it), as part of an artistic form or design. Otherwise, please adhere to the license rules, which can be found here . I would be glad if you post a link to your finished product on Freesound.org, or a video review of it (in the comments to one or more of my sounds) with a short text stating that this sound was used in this project. This will be a kind of small gratitude for my work. And, of course, it's always interesting to see the live context in which my sounds are used. Thank you.
